purpose: Reconcile the Claver article's fish-site wording, figure/table spelling differences, administrative-place conflict and publicly linked correction/voucher material before making any species-to-waterbody assertion.

targetedSearches: Exact article title with correction, erratum, corrigendum and supplement terms
DOI with voucher, museum specimen, station and supplement terms
Article title with printed fish taxa and river/system terms
boundedSearch.result: No separately indexed correction, supplement, museum accession list or independent voucher record was located in this bounded web search. This does not prove that none exists and does not constitute a collection census. No author or institution was contacted.

sourceDetail.fishResultsAsReported: The results prose says three 2023 fish species were recorded across Station 4 downstream, Stations 13 and 15 upstream, and midstream; it names Cyprinidae sp. from upstream and Lethrinus sp. from downstream, while the exact station/taxon mapping is incomplete. For 2022, the prose groups tilapia and rabbitfish as midstream and squirrelfish, crescent grunter and blackfin scad at the river mouth. These are broad author-reported reach classes, not a complete station-by-taxon table.
sourceDetail.captionAndTableLabelDifference: Table 4 prints Cyprinidae sp.; the Figure 4 caption prints Cyperinidae sp. Table 4 and Figure 4 print Halocentrus sp. An earlier Bangwit transcription incorrectly used Holocentrus sp.; corrected to the article's Halocentrus sp. The alternate Cyperinidae figure-caption form is retained as printed and is not silently normalized.
sourceDetail.figureEvidence: Figure 4 associates photo panels with names and collection dates and shows rulers, but supplies no station-level photo metadata, voucher accession or repository, and no independent identification record.
sourceDetail.administrativePlaceConflict: Title, abstract, body text and figure captions identify Claver, Surigao del Norte. Captions for Tables 1-4 and the conclusion state Surigao del Sur. No resolution is published in the reviewed article or linked page.
sourceDetail.correctionResult: No correction/erratum link appears on the publisher landing page, which links the full-text PDF. The bounded exact-title/DOI search did not locate a separate correction notice; absence is not established.

limitations: The exact station/taxon relationship for the three 2023 labels is incomplete; do not infer the unspoken link by elimination.
The 2022 prose and Table 4 allow only broad reach-class context; no precise station identity or salinity is documented for each fish.
An unlocated correction or voucher in this bounded search is not evidence that one does not exist.
The Surigao del Norte/Surigao del Sur conflict is unresolved; do not use this study to draw a waterbody boundary or silently relocate its records.
No external author contact was made and no specimen identity or present occurrence is verified.
nextAction: Keep this study research-only. Continue with a bounded read-only public-voucher query only if the occurrence provider exposes collection identifiers and usable locality fields; aggregate material citations must not be treated as independent vouchers.

references.supports: Publisher landing page, abstract and the full-text link; no separate correction or supplement link was listed on the page reviewed.
Primary source for the incomplete reach grouping, Figure 4/ Table 4 label variants, date-to-photo labels and the Surigao del Norte/Surigao del Sur conflict.
